name: Vintage Story
hint: Dedicated server for the wilderness survival sandbox, joined over IPv6

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players need their own Vintage Story account and game version 1.22. They join from Multiplayer, Add New Server, typing the app's address under Host / IP Address. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server.

MAX_PLAYERS.title: Max players
MAX_PLAYERS.description: Vintage Story suggests 1 GB of memory plus 300 MB per player, so raise the app's memory for more.

ADMIN_PLAYER.title: Admin player name
ADMIN_PLAYER.description: Vintage Story account given admin rights at each start.
